question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 20 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The new UI flow feature flag change likely caused the increase in latency.
why_chain: The new UI flow feature flag change to 50% in eu-west led to increased latency.
Increased latency is a known side effect of feature flag changes.
The change in feature flag occurred 2 minutes before the latency increase, supporting a temporal relationship.

contributing_factors.description: The flash sale campaign likely caused the increase in request volume and error rate.
why_chain: The flash sale campaign went live at the same time as the latency increase.
The increase in request volume and error rate are consistent with a sudden spike in traffic.
The campaign is a known cause of such spikes in traffic and errors.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The deployment of auth v3.26 to us-east was the cause.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment was in a different region and service, making it unlikely to be the cause.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for region eu-west rose from 137 ms to 246 ms (+80%), with a change point at 2026-03-20T02:35:00Z.
The change is concentrated in region eu-west: 4 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for region eu-west rose (2132 per 5 min before, 7230 per 5 min after, +239%).
At the same time, error rate for region eu-west rose (0.39% before, 0.80% after, +105%).
Changed auth feature flag new_ui_flow to 50% in eu-west (auth, eu-west; 2 min before the change; record R011; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Marketing: flash sale campaign goes live in eu-west at 02:35 UTC (eu-west; 242 min before the change; record R008; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Request volume 3x normal in eu-west (eu-west; 12 min after the change; record R012; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
autoscaler: scaling out, 4 new instances requested (eu-west; 20 min after the change; record R013; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
Deployed auth v3.26 to us-east (routine release) (auth, us-east; 200 min before the change; record R010; fit: different service/region, so unlikely to be the cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (config_changes) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 2 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✗ Request volume also rose, so a traffic explanation is still open.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Roll back the new UI flow feature flag change to 50% in eu-west.
Implement traffic management and rate limiting for the flash sale campaign.
Monitor and adjust the autoscaler to prevent unnecessary scaling out.
